BRIGHTON BAY COFFEE ROASTERS
Thank You Coupon

Bring this coupon to the counter at either Brighton Bay shop and take 20 percent off one bag of whole-bean coffee. The coupon may be used together with the monthly loyalty discount, but it cannot be applied to gift cards or brewing equipment.

Valid from November 1 through December 15. A photocopy will be accepted as long as the barcode is readable, so feel free to pass a copy to a friend. Limit one coupon per customer per visit.

Our Harbor Blend is roasted on Tuesday and Thursday mornings at the Dock Street shop. Bags are carried to the Elm Avenue shop the following day. Customers who want the freshest bag should therefore visit Dock Street on those days.

Ask about our two-week sampler size, a smaller bag priced the same per ounce as a standard one.

Rosewood Medical Group
Facilities Committee Meeting, October 9
Present: Angela Ruiz (chair), Dev Patel, Lorna Fisk, Kenji Abe

1. Parking. Ms. Fisk reported that complaints about crowded parking have fallen since the Oak Street clinic ended its evening hours in September, though staff still struggle to find spaces before 8 A.M. Mr. Patel proposed leasing spaces in the lot behind the bakery. Mr. Abe asked that the group first count how many spaces staff members actually use, since several of them already park at the bakery by private arrangement. The committee agreed.

2. Waiting room. Ms. Ruiz presented three quotes for replacing worn chairs. The committee chose the second, whose fabric can be wiped clean, even though it costs the most, and asked the vendor to shorten the delivery time of eight weeks.

3. Signs. Mr. Abe will ask the printer whether directional signs can be ready before the December open house.

Action: Mr. Abe will report the parking count at the next meeting on November 6.

Lakeside Print & Copy: Business Services Price List

Banner printing (vinyl, 3 feet by 6 feet): $48 each
  Regular turnaround: 5 business days
  Express turnaround: 2 business days (add $15 per order)
Brochures (tri-fold, full color): $0.85 each, any quantity from 100 to 1,000
Business cards (box of 250): $22
Poster printing (18 by 24 inches): $14 each
Binding and lamination: $3 per document

Delivery is $9 within the Lakeside district and $16 beyond it, regardless of order size. Pickup is free.
Custom designs: Our in-house designer prepares artwork for $40 per hour. Please send files in PDF format to reduce delays.

Orders are accepted online, by phone, or at the counter. Business days are Monday through Friday, and holidays are not counted. Payment is due when the order is placed, and a deposit is requested only for orders over $200.

docs.title: Online review
docs.text:
Rating: 4 out of 5 stars. Reliable shop with one small surprise
Posted by Marisol Vega, November 6

I own a small bakery and needed 600 brochures and two banners for our grand reopening on November 8. I placed my order on October 30 and chose the regular turnaround for the banners because I assumed that I had plenty of time. When I stopped by on November 5, the brochures were ready and looked great, but the banners were not. Mr. Tran, the owner, explained that my regular order was due the next day, then offered to bring the banners to my bakery himself. They arrived on the morning of November 6, and the quality was excellent. The brochures were folded neatly, and the colors matched our menu closely, and the folding was done by hand. The shop is a short walk from my bakery, and Mr. Tran remembered me from an earlier visit when I bought business cards. I would also suggest sending the shop a finished file, since the designer's hourly fee added up when my first layout needed several changes.

docs.title: Invitation
docs.text:
You Are Invited!
Harlow & Finch Architects
10th Anniversary Celebration

Join us on Saturday, March 14, from 5:00 P.M. to 8:00 P.M. at the Millrace Gallery, 82 Canal Street, to celebrate a decade of designing spaces for the Tidewater community.

Guests will enjoy a short exhibit of our past projects, live jazz, and refreshments from Olive & Thyme Catering. Parking is available at the Canal Street garage; validation will be provided at the door.

Please reply by March 2 to Jenna Park at jpark@harlowfinch.example. Business attire is not required. The gallery doors will open to all guests at 5:00 P.M., and the exhibit will be set up along the main hall.

docs.title: E-mail 1
docs.text:
To: Jenna Park
From: Rafael Souza
Date: February 24
Subject: Anniversary celebration

Dear Ms. Park,

Thank you for inviting me and my wife, Elena, to the anniversary event. We would be delighted to attend. Because Elena uses a wheelchair, I wanted to ask whether the Millrace Gallery has an entrance without steps. If it does not, could you suggest another arrival point? Also, Elena has a severe allergy to shellfish, so we would appreciate learning in advance whether any of the dishes contain it. We will be driving in from Eastport, and I would rather not search for the right door once we arrive. My company built the shelving for your Fenwick Library renovation four years ago, and I am glad to see your firm doing so well.

Sincerely,
Rafael Souza

docs.title: E-mail 2
docs.text:
To: Rafael Souza
From: Jenna Park
Date: February 25
Subject: RE: Anniversary celebration

Dear Mr. Souza,

We are delighted that you and Elena can join us. The main doors on Canal Street have steps, but there is a ramp at the side entrance on Pike Lane, and a staff member will meet you there at 4:45 P.M. so you can arrive ahead of the crowd. I have checked with the caterer, and none of the dishes include shellfish, and the menu will be posted on our Web site by March 10. Please let me know if you need a reserved parking space; the garage is two blocks from the ramp.

Best regards,
Jenna Park
Harlow & Finch Architects
